title: kate-syntax: Definition model and KSyntaxHighlighting XML loader, first vendored definitions
summary: The data side of syntax highlighting. Rust types for the KSyntaxHighlighting language.xsd format (definition, contexts, rules, keyword lists, formats, folding, comments) and a quick-xml loader that resolves context switches, IncludeRules and cross-definition references into dense ids. Vendors six MIT-licensed definitions (rust, cpp, c, json, markdown, cmake) with their license headers and a SOURCES.md that names the upstream commit. No matching engine yet; that is PKT-0008.

lane.reason: XML parsing into plain data with a large, well-specified schema. Independent of every other crate, so it runs in parallel with the kate-text lane. Needs the upstream submodule checked out to copy the six XML files and read language.xsd.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: New crate API. Dependency to be added with justification: quick-xml (streaming XML parser; std has none). Vendored XML files are data, licensed MIT upstream, copied verbatim with headers. Only files whose `license` attribute is MIT may be vendored by this packet; others wait for the owner's license decision.

regression_tests.name: repository::tests::six_vendored_definitions_load_and_link
regression_tests.asserts: add_xml for each vendored file succeeds, link() succeeds, and every ContextSwitch::Push target is a valid index into contexts.

regression_tests.name: repository::tests::include_rules_are_inlined_in_order
regression_tests.asserts: A minimal two-definition fixture with IncludeRules produces a context whose rules equal the included rules spliced at the IncludeRules position.

regression_tests.name: repository::tests::unknown_context_reference_is_an_error_naming_it
regression_tests.asserts: A fixture referencing context 'Nope' fails link() with UnknownContext { context: 'Nope', .. }.

regression_tests.name: repository::tests::file_name_matching_prefers_priority
regression_tests.asserts: for_file_name('CMakeLists.txt') is cmake; for_file_name('main.rs') is rust; for_file_name('x.unknownext') is None.
